messages:
Olivia (Sales): Hey team — ACME's InfoSec sent back the vendor risk review asking for detailed BCP/DR evidence. They want RTO/RPO numbers by service tier, backup cadence & retention, recent failover test results, and the DR runbook. Also asking about SLA credits and any POC validation we can offer. Can someone pull artefacts?
Jaime (Solutions): Got it. I can assemble a concise bundle. Quick q: do they need signed attestation or just logs/artifacts?
Olivia (Sales): They said 'evidence suitable for risk committee' — prefer signed/testing artefacts if we can. If not, detailed logs + runbook steps are OK for now.
Evan (SRE): I can export last quarter's failover test logs and the automated backup job history. Our standard for hosted API: RTO = 5m for control plane, 15m for model serving fallback, RPO = 1m (KV/cache warmup considered). I'll pull the test runbook and post links.
Asha (Security): We'll need the change control ticket references and the DR test signoff (who executed, duration, postmortem notes). Also include key management notes (KMS rotation schedule) and encryption-at-rest confirmation.
Olivia (Sales): Perfect. Also ACME asked whether Dedicated/Private deployments have different RTO/RPO/SLA.
Jaime (Solutions): Yes — Dedicated has similar RTO but different failover (customer pools + optional active-active across AZs). Private (on-prem/VPC) depends on customer infra; we'll provide configuration guidance and typical expectations. I'll draft language.
Evan (SRE): Short summary block I can drop into the bundle:
```
- Hosted API: SLA 99.95% uptime, target RTO (model serving fallback) = 15 minutes, RPO <= 1 minute for token cacheable endpoints.
- Dedicated: SLA negotiable (99.95% baseline), failover within 15-30 minutes depending on network teardown, RPO typically 5 minutes for mature infra.
- Private: Operationally constrained by customer; we provide runbook + integration guidance.
- Backups: Daily full meta backups, continuous incremental for customer data, retention 90 days by default, longer on request.
- Testing cadence: quarterly DR exercises; last test: 2025-02-03; artifacts: logs + postmortem.
```
Jaime (Solutions): I'll add the POC-specific offer: run a controlled failover exercise during POC window, we can demonstrate detection, KV-cache warmup, and routing fallback to a compatible smaller model. Customer gets the test logs and a short replay.
Asha (Security): For vendor risk teams, include signed attestation (from Ops manager) and the runbook PDF. Also flag that Private deployments can integrate with customer KMS/HSM; include link to KMS integration doc.
Olivia (Sales): Awesome. ACME also asked about SLA credits formula and historical uptime evidence for the last 12 months.
Evan (SRE): SLA credits: standard template — credit = % of monthly invoice capped at 50% based on downtime bands. I'll attach our uptime dashboard export (anonymized metrics) and monthly availability CSV for past 12 months.
Olivia (Sales): Anything blockers for publishing this bundle today?
Jaime (Solutions): I need Asha to sign the attestation PDF and Evan to drop the sanitized logs + postmortem. If we get those, I can assemble a single S3 package and share a pre-signed link.
Asha (Security): I'll review the draft attestation and sign by EOD. Need to confirm exact wording re: encryption keys.
Evan (SRE): Uploading artifacts now: s3://redwood-evidence/bcp/ACME/2025-02-03/ (contains failover-logs.csv, backup-jobs.json, postmortem.pdf). Added sanitized uptime.csv to same folder.
sec-bot: Automated note: Attached artifacts were scanned for secrets and no high-risk findings were detected.
Jaime (Solutions): Draft bundle checklist I used:
- RTO/RPO summary (short)
- Backup cadence & retention docs
- DR runbook (PDF)
- Failover test logs + postmortem (signed)
- SLA doc + availability export
- KMS/HSM integration note
- POC offer: controlled failover demo
I'll stitch and upload to a signed S3 link for Olivia to share.
Olivia (Sales): This is great — once the link is up I'll send to ACME and offer the POC failover slot next week. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Jaime (Solutions): Link (prelim): https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-evidence/bcp/ACME/2025-02-03/bundle-1850123456.zip?quickView=true (will swap to pre-signed for customer)
Asha (Security): Signed attestation uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/bcp/ACME/2025-02-03/attestation-signed.pdf
Evan (SRE): Added uptime-12mo-anonymized.csv and the failover run commands used in test:
```
# failover test commands (sanitized)
redwoodctl drain --pool=hosting-prod --grace=30s
redwoodctl promote --replica=pool-bak
monitoring query --since=\"2025-02-03T00:00Z\" --query=\"p95_latency\" > p95.csv
```
Olivia (Sales): Sending to ACME now. I'll post follow-up if they request clarifications or want the POC scheduling.
Jaime (Solutions): If they ask for RPO proof per endpoint, we can also run a targeted data-recovery demo during POC. FYI.
Olivia (Sales): Noted. Closing thread once ACME confirms receipt.
